displayName: Orshot: Automate video, PDF and image generation from templates and social media posting (OG images, social media posts, carousels, thumbnails, invoices, certificates)
description: Automate video, PDF and image generation from templates and social media posting. Image generation, PDF generation and video generation from your templates over the hosted Orshot MCP server (OAuth, no key) or REST: OG images, social media posts, carousels, thumbnails, ad creatives, certificates, invoices, video with animations, Smart Resize, batch renders, tweet and website screenshots, and scheduling or posting to Instagram, LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest and 7 more.
